newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' prices mixed with copper unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' prices mixed with copper unchanged.

text.p: Indian metals' prices were unchanged on Wednesday as state firms retained previous selling prices, dealers said.
They said nickel, tin, zinc and lead gained while copper and aluminium were unchanged. State firms, Hindustan Zinc Ltd and Hindustan Copper Ltd maintained previous selling rates.

Ready zinc rose by 50 rupees to 6,550 rupees per quintal and lead rose by the same margin to 4,450. Copper was steady at 12,550 rupees per quintal. Tin gained by 100 rupees to 34,600 rupees per quintal while nickel rose by same margin at 36,900. Aluminium traded at last level of 7,200 rupees per quintal.
